tools.name: tengu_regime

tools.name: tengu_logs

tools.name: tengu_v2_drift

tools.name: tengu_v2_feature_importance

tools.name: tengu_v2_factor_decay

tools.name: tengu_v2_regime_forecast

tools.name: tengu_v2_regime_history
tools.description: Historical regime labels over the last N days (default 180). Call it when the user asks how long the current regime has lasted, when the last regime shift happened, or wants past behavior broken out by regime.

tools.name: tengu_v2_var
tools.description: Portfolio VaR and CVaR at a chosen horizon and confidence (defaults: 1-day, 99%). Call it when the user asks 'how much could the portfolio lose?' or needs a tail-risk number before sizing or hedging decisions.

tools.name: tengu_v2_stress

tools.name: tengu_v2_crash_scenarios
tools.description: Historical crash replay through past market crash episodes. Call it when the user asks 'how would this have held up in previous crashes?' or wants tail risk anchored to real historical events; use tengu_v2_stress for hypothetical scenarios.

tools.name: tengu_v2_signal_correlation
tools.description: Correlation matrix across the voter signals feeding the ensemble. Call it when the user asks whether the model's signals are independent or redundant — high pairwise correlation means the vote count overstates conviction.

tools.name: tengu_v2_short_interest

tools.name: tengu_v2_alpha_discoveries

tools.name: tengu_v3_ultimate_decision

tools.name: tengu_v3_slippage
tools.description: Realised slippage stats (mean/median/p95)

tools.name: tengu_v3_twap_plan

tools.name: tengu_v3_signals_cross_asset

tools.name: tengu_v3_self_healing
